title: Area tags
text:
Area tags

Area details supported by 
UNICEDE
/2.

Area tabs (a.k.a. area and subarea codes) vary 
by country and by version
 of
 
UNICEDE
/2. Some countries support multiple
 subareas (e.g. CRESTA and District). Not all of the listed subareas are supported for
 Market Share imports.

Navigate to the 
UNICEDE
/2 version and country listing to view available area and subarea codes.
